items.name: styles
items.description: Plex UI design tokens and component styles (import from your main stylesheet after Tailwind).

items.name: button
items.description: Button for an action, in four variants and eight semantic colors, and ButtonLink, a link styled as a button.

items.name: button-group
items.description: Join buttons into a single visual unit for toolbars, steppers, split buttons and search affordances.

items.name: context-menu
items.description: "A menu of actions for an element, opened by a secondary click or, on a touch screen, a touch and hold."

items.name: menu
items.description: Dropdown menu for structured actions, with grouped items, submenus, and checkbox and radio items.

items.name: swipe-actions
items.description: "Actions behind a row of a list, revealed by a swipe across the row, as the swipe actions of an iOS list."

items.name: text-link
items.description: "A link in running text, to a page of the app or another site, that takes the color of the text around it."

items.name: field
items.description: Form field wrapper that links a label, helper text and an error message to its control.

items.name: file-upload
items.description: Mobile-first file upload with type and size validation, several files, error states and file cards.

items.name: floating-label-input
items.description: Text input whose label floats above its value, with helper and error text and a multi-line variant.

items.name: input
items.description: Text input with start and end adornments, a clear button and a password visibility toggle.

items.name: input-group
items.description: Input or textarea with icons, text, buttons and menus attached inside one frame, inline or as rows.

items.name: markdown-editor
items.description: Compact rich text editor powered by Tiptap, for a form field, with a markdown formatting toolbar.

items.name: otp-input
items.description: "A field for one-time passwords and verification codes, entered one digit per cell, with autofill."

items.name: tag-input
items.description: Input for entering multiple unique values as chip-style tokens, with suggestions and keyboard editing.

items.name: textarea
items.description: "A text field of several lines for longer input, which can grow with its content."

items.name: checkbox
items.description: Checkbox for binary on/off selection, with solid, pill and ghost variants and an indeterminate state.

items.name: color-picker
items.description: "A color well and the iOS color picker it opens, for choosing a color from a grid, a spectrum or sliders."

items.name: date-input
items.description: Masked text input for typing dates and times, with automatic formatting, min and max limits, and validation.

items.name: date-picker
items.description: Date picker with a calendar, a time picker, month and year dropdowns, and min and max limits.

items.name: date-range-picker
items.description: Date range picker with a calendar, min and max limits, preset shortcuts and a month stepper.

items.name: radio-group
items.description: "A group of options from which a person chooses exactly one, as a list, a row, cards or settings rows."

items.name: segmented-control
items.description: "One control that switches between related views, as a segmented track or as underline tabs."

items.name: select
items.description: "A dropdown for choosing one or more options from a list; on a phone, an iOS pop-up menu."

items.name: slider
items.description: "A slider for choosing a number or a range on a scale, with marks and a value that can be typed."

items.name: stepper
items.description: "Two segments that decrease and increase a number in steps, as the iOS 26 stepper does."

items.name: switch
items.description: "A switch that turns a setting on or off, with an optional label and description."

items.name: toggle-group
items.description: "A row of buttons that each stay pressed or not, any number at a time, such as the days an alarm repeats on."

items.name: breadcrumb
items.description: The trail of pages that leads to the current one, above a page title, with links and the current page.

items.name: index-bar
items.description: "The section index of a phone list: a column of letters at its trailing edge that jumps to a section."

items.name: navigation-row
items.description: "A list row that opens a page of its own, with a label, the current value and a chevron, as in iOS Settings."

items.name: page
items.description: "The frame of an app page: a header and its content in one column, the header a glass bar on a phone."

items.name: page-control
items.description: "A row of dots, one per page, that shows where a person is in a flat list of pages and moves between them."

items.name: sidebar
items.description: "A navigation sidebar for an app shell that folds to an icon rail and becomes a drawer on a phone."

items.name: tab-bar
items.description: "The tab bar of a phone screen: the top-level sections of an app in a glass capsule at the bottom."

items.name: toolbar
items.description: "The top and bottom bars of a phone screen: navigation, a title, a search field and actions over the content."

items.name: dialog
items.description: Modal dialog for confirmations, forms and destructive alerts, with a focus trap and an overlay scrim.

items.name: popover
items.description: A floating panel for contextual UI, with flexible sizing, hover triggers, a controllable open state and nesting.

items.name: tip
items.description: "A short message that points out a feature people might miss, in the page or anchored to a control."

items.name: toast
items.description: "A brief notification that gives feedback on an action, with an optional description and action button."

items.name: tooltip
items.description: "Brief text that explains a control, shown on hover or keyboard focus."

items.name: alert
items.description: Inline message for notices and warnings, with semantic colors, a title, a description and actions.

items.name: empty-message
items.description: Empty state that tells users there's nothing to show, for errors, warnings, no results and onboarding.

items.name: indicators
items.description: "Loading and progress indicators: spinners, determinate progress rings and animated dots."

items.name: progress
items.description: "A horizontal bar that shows how far a task has come, or a sweep while its length is unknown."

items.name: progress-steps
items.description: "A stepper that shows the steps of a multi-step flow, such as a checkout or onboarding, and the current one."

items.name: shimmer-text
items.description: Text with a shimmer animation for loading and in-progress states, always on or toggled with a graceful stop.

items.name: skeleton
items.description: "Loading placeholders in the shape of the content they stand in for, from avatars and text to cards and lists."

items.name: accordion
items.description: Vertically stacked panels that expand to reveal content, with one or several items open at a time.

items.name: avatar
items.description: An avatar for a user identity that shows an initial, a photo, an icon or an overflow count.

items.name: avatar-group
items.description: Stacks user avatars into a single overlapping cluster, with one size for the whole group.

items.name: badge
items.description: Compact label for statuses and inline metadata, with semantic colors, variants, sizes and icons.

items.name: card
items.description: A surface that groups a title, a description, content and actions, in an outline, solid or ghost style.

items.name: code-block
items.description: Code block with syntax highlighting, a copy button, and collapsible long snippets.

items.name: data-table
items.description: "Table of your data on TanStack Table v8, with sorting, pagination, filtering and row selection."

items.name: kbd
items.description: A key or a keyboard shortcut, such as ⌘K, set inline in text, in a tooltip or at the end of a menu item.

items.name: markdown
items.description: Markdown renderer for rich formatted content, with headings, lists, tables, code blocks and KaTeX math.

items.name: rolling-number
items.description: "A number whose digits roll to a new value, as an odometer's do, for a count that changes while it is watched."

items.name: separator
items.description: "A thin line that divides content: the rows of a list or, standing vertically, inline items."

items.name: stats-card
items.description: "A dashboard card that shows one figure, such as a KPI, with its trend, an icon or a progress bar."

items.name: table
items.description: "Table parts for structured data on native table elements: header, body, footer, rows, cells and a caption."
